svg.text: Public AI for every commune — system architecture (prototype, 6 October 2026)
A static page, a presenter-operated proxy that holds the key, Apertus 1.5 70B via Swisscom, and a fixed catalogue of public pages.
Blue arrows: runtime requests, numbered in order. Grey dashed: operations. Ochre: the visitor's browser opening a third-party page directly.
1 · Visitor's device
Any browser, no login. Journey saved here; relevant text sent to the model.
index.html — one file, no build, no dependencies
Story · sentence with underlined facts, answers, transcript, follow-up
Map · SVG tree, dashed fork for a proposal, “?” open questions
Detail · step, references (page + note + status), explanation, plan
Guards, run in the browser before anything is drawn
• balanced-JSON parser; cut answers repaired to the last complete step
• source ids must exist in CATALOG; note ids must exist on that entry
• a “variable” must be literally in the sentence, else it becomes a question
• malformed map → one shorter retry; incomplete maps are not cached
• proposal before apply (keep / adopt); Explore never writes the path
• every text labelled: model (provider, model) · catalogue note · you
Map cache key = hash(language, sentence, variable values, answers)
Follow-up: answers from map + notes only; a fact → editable proposed sentence
localStorage — this browser only
sentence · variables · answers · done marks (both scoped) · cached maps
transcript + language (localStorage) · proxy address (sessionStorage)
“Start over” removes the saved journey; requests send text and map context to the provider.
CATALOG — embedded in index.html, 14 entries
id · level (commune / canton / Confederation / other) · exact URL
draft notes (EN, FR) of what the page covers; the only references the model may cite
Status today: all notes draft, no reviewer, no checked date
Planned pack: condition · office · page + claim · checked date + reviewer
· dependencies — one file per commune, versioned
2 · GitHub — artfisica / zh-ai-weeks-build-a-public-ai-service-proposal
Hosts page, code, checks and proxy. Repo stores no visitor stories.
GitHub Pages — static hosting
artfisica.github.io/zh-ai-weeks-…/
serves index.html, proxy-url.json, demo.gif, docs
cannot hold a secret → hence the proxy
Repository · main
index.html · proxy/ · tests/ · docs: README, SPEC,
DEMO, PILOT, EVALUATION · LICENSE · NOTICE
Actions: node --check · check-inline · smoke
GitHub Codespace “laughing-cod” — presenter-operated, sleeps when idle
.devcontainer: Node 20 image, gh CLI, forwards port 8787, declares the three secrets
proxy/server.js — Node 20, no dependencies, listens on :8787
GET /health → ready · provider · model · maxTokens · processing · budget
POST /chat → checks Origin, budget, caller limit → injects key → forwards
Origin allow-list (not authentication) · daily cap 120 requests · per-caller hourly cap
max_tokens ≤ 3500 · adds provenance {provider, model} to every answer
Codespaces secrets → environment
APERTUS_API_KEY · UPSTREAM_BASE
UPSTREAM_MODEL · UPSTREAM_PROCESSING?
never in the repo, never in the page
.budget.json — local disk
request counters only: today's total,
per caller per hour
message text is not deliberately retained
proxy/start.sh — on start, idempotent
git pull → start node → wait for /health
gh codespace ports visibility 8787:public
write proxy-url.json → commit → push
Idle timeout stops the machine (240 min);
keep-alive only counts with the tab open.
A changed server.js needs pkill node first.
Public address — TLS by GitHub
https://laughing-cod-qjjw5vpqgg3x5xg
-8787.app.github.dev
Stable while the Codespace exists.
If private after a restart,
start.sh sets it public again.
Not a production endpoint.
3 · Model provider
Swiss {ai} Weeks hackathon endpoint — temporary key, will expire
Swisscom Swiss AI Platform — Apertus 1.5 70B
POST https://api.swisscom.com/products/swiss-ai-weeks/
apertus-1.5-70b/v1/chat/completions · model: swiss-ai/Apertus-v1.5-70B · Bearer key
OpenAI-compatible · compact JSON · observed 10–30 s
Malformed maps can retry once; provider quota is temporary
Processing region shown only when independently verified and configured
Story, answers, follow-ups and map context are processed here under provider terms.
Apertus writes steps, explanations and questions. It cannot add a URL:
it may only cite CATALOG ids; anything else is dropped by the browser (zone 1).
The code restricts links, not the truth of a sentence → everything is labelled “proposed”.
4 · Official pages and tools — third parties
Opened directly by the visitor's browser. Never fetched or scraped by the service.
Each catalogue entry is one of these pages plus a draft note of what it covers.
The badge names the page's publisher; the node ring is the model's proposed authority level.
Review status today: 14 entries, 0 reviewed by a public authority.
A reviewed pack would add: supported claim · checked date · reviewer · contact office.
Found with the tool on 6 Oct: Vaud's eDéménagement page lists Nyon and St-Cergue as
participating communes, not Gland — a real local fork, verifiable on a dated page.
push proxy-url.json → repo → Pages
Presenter
opens the Codespace · bash proxy/start.sh · keeps the tab alive
Runtime sequence
1 GET index.html, then proxy-url.json (no-store).
2 GET /health. The page refuses a proxy that is not ready, that lacks maxTokens (an old server process), or that caps under 2500 tokens.
3 POST /chat — system: role, rules, CATALOG with notes · user: sentence, current values, answers, previous map ids for stability, optional change · max_tokens 3000, temperature 0.2.
4 The proxy checks Origin, budget and caller limit, injects the key and forwards. 5 The model returns compact JSON; the proxy adds {provider, model}.
6 The browser validates (guards above), renders, caches. 7 A visitor opens a reference: the selected page loads directly from its publisher.
Follow-up turns reuse 3–6 with a shorter prompt (map + notes + question, 700 tokens).
A proposed change (“Gland instead”) is a second map fetched with the previous map's ids and diffed by id in the browser: same / changed / added / removed.
Language switch refetches without the previous map so texts come back in the chosen language.
Planned — not in the current system
• Always-on proxy with documented jurisdiction and operating ownership.
Replaces the Codespace; the page only needs a new proxy-url.json.
• Provider switch by env values, with processing location confirmed for each provider.
• Commune packs: reviewed claims with date, reviewer, scope and office; a deterministic
layer applies conditions, Apertus interprets words and explains changes (PILOT.md, 6 weeks).
• One dated Open Journey Planner point on the transport branch, kept apart from guidance.
• The 10-situation evaluation set (EVALUATION.md) run against the live model, then nightly.
• German and Italian: strings and prompts are already switchable.
What is stored where, today
zone 1 — saved journey · zone 2 — repo, proxy and request counters
zone 3 — request text and map context · zone 4 — publisher receives direct page visit
Trust boundary: the key never crosses from zone 2 to zone 1; personal text never enters zone 2's repo.
